You are implementing Task C2: Chat store with streaming — part of PR-C (live Claude chat in the console) for the ruflo-console Claude Code plugin (TypeScript "function hooks" mod).

## Task Description
Read your task brief first: C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-console-win\.superpowers\sdd\2026-10-10-ruflo-console-windows-nav-chat\task-C2-brief.md
Also binding (plan Review Focus #4): "Tool-only assistant messages, messages over 20 KB, the 4,096-entry cap: chat renders a placeholder, cuts long text, never freezes."

## Context
- Work from: C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-console-chat (git worktree, branch feat/console-chat). Plugin dir: plugins/ruflo-console. Windows 11, Node 24.
- Task C1 (commit 58081a9) added hooks/chat-msg.ts (`ChatMsg = { role: 'user'|'assistant'; text: string; tools: string[] }`, `toChatMsgs`) and `Host.session.{ messages(): Promise<ChatMsg[]>, id(): Promise<string> }` bound in register.ts `hostOf`. Also add a `(row.toolUses ?? [])` guard in toChatMsgs (controller ruling; a user row without toolUses must not throw).
- Privacy pattern to copy: hooks/sessions.ts:2-6 keeps transcript-derived data in a side-table WeakMap keyed by the State so it never reaches snapshots, exports, persistence or console_state text. Do the same for the chat store. Transcript text must never be written to disk, never put in console_state text, never sent to a model by the console.
- STREAMING HOOK — HIGH RISK: `turn.step` is a streaming event delivered to async-generator hooks; chunks of kind 'text' carry `{ kind:'text', index, text }`. Your hook observes text chunks and must pass the stream through UNCHANGED (`return yield* next(e)` or the exact pattern the d.ts documents). Grep the engine declaration (do not read it whole) C:/Users/mariu/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/bundled-skills/2.1.286/e9359f1bd6280f63d9d038bce106683a/plugin-authoring/types/claude-code.d.ts for `'turn.step'`, `TurnStepChunk`, `TurnStepTextChunk`, `async generator`/`yield*`, and read the reference doc C:/Users/mariu/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/bundled-skills/2.1.286/e9359f1bd6280f63d9d038bce106683a/plugin-authoring/reference.md section on streaming events, BEFORE writing the hook. Also `turn.complete` input (`agentId?`, `answer`, `isAborted`, `turnId`) and `turn.start`. Look at how register.ts already hooks `turn.start`/`turn.complete` (≈ lines 400-432) and extend those rather than adding duplicate hooks if possible. Only the MAIN session counts (`e.agentId === undefined`); subagent turns are ignored. Never throw out of these hooks (a throwing hook is skipped by the engine but must not break the turn); keep the per-chunk work O(1) (append to a string with a hard cap, e.g. 20,000 chars).
- Produces (exact, from the brief): `chatOf(state): { msgs: ChatMsg[]; partial: string; pending: 'idle' | 'sending' | 'queued'; error?: string }` and `refreshChat(host, state): Promise<void>` keeping the last 200 messages, each text cut at 20,000 chars with "… cut". A tool-only assistant message (empty text, tools present) is stored so the view (next task) can render "… used <tools>" — decide whether that placeholder text lives in the store or the view and say so (prefer the view; the store keeps data).
- Engine rule: `claude plugin validate plugins/ruflo-console` must pass (from the worktree root) — it also lists which events the module hooks; include that in the report.
- vitest: from plugins/ruflo-console `node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/<file>.spec.ts` (node_modules is a git-ignored junction — never commit it). Write tests/chat-store.spec.ts. Test the turn.step hook by driving it with a fake async-generator `next` and asserting (1) every chunk the fake upstream yields comes out unchanged and in order, (2) the return value of next is returned, (3) partial grows only for main-session text chunks, (4) a throwing store update does not alter the stream. Plus the brief's tests (partial clears on complete; subagent turns ignored; 25 KB cut; tool-only message stored with tools; 4,096 in → 200 kept). Record related specs' failing set on base first (any spec touching register.ts turn hooks), compare after.
- No new dependencies. Touch only plugins/ruflo-console. Do not push.
- Commit message: `feat(console): chat store mirrors the live session, streaming`, ending with exactly `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <[REDACTED:email]>`.

## Your Job
Read the API first, then TDD (RED → GREEN), related specs base vs head, validate, commit, self-review, report. NEEDS_CONTEXT rather than guess — especially about the generator pass-through contract.

## You Do Not Dispatch Subagents

## Report (required)
Write C:\Users\mariu\ruflo-wt-console-win\.superpowers\sdd\2026-10-10-ruflo-console-windows-nav-chat\task-C2-report.md (the d.ts/reference lines for turn.step pass-through you relied on; design; RED/GREEN; specs base vs head; validator output incl. hooked events; files; self-review; concerns).
Then reply ONLY (<15 lines): Status, commits, one-line test summary, concerns, report path.

4. Nothing redraws the UI after the refresh lands or as chunks stream; the view task needs to.

7. Typecheck used the 2.1.286 types, which lack `agentId` on `turn.start` input. register.ts already relied on it (line 406); my line 407 copies that. No other errors in the changed files.
